title: Prince Ali Rescue
start: Speak to Hassan in the palace at Al Kharid.

items.t: 7 balls of wool (or 3 balls of wool and a rope)
3 beers (if you accidentally drink one you can refill at the barrel in Morgan's warehouse)

recommended.t: Activated Al Kharid and Draynor lodestone.
Alternatively, if you are a member, you can buy a charged amulet of glory.

rewards.t: Free passage through the Lumbridge - Al Kharid toll gate upon completion
Access to Sorceress's Garden minigame (members only)
Ability to Enchant the Broomstick with unlimited teleport charges to the Sorceress's Garden (members only)
Two extra spins on the Squeal of Fortune

steps.t: Exit the palace and meet with Osman. He tells you that Prince Ali, Al Kharid's heir to the throne, has been kidnapped by a certain Lady Keli, who plans to hold the prince for ransom. Fortunately, Osman has a plan to save the prince - tie up Lady Keli, and disguise the prince, to look like his abductor, and finally escape in plain sight.
p: The starting point for the quest.

steps.t: Osman directs you to his daughter, Leela, who could be found strolling east of Draynor Village, near the field.

For members who had completed The Fremennik Isles, you could go to Ned without coins. Ask him for a rope, and say you don't enough coins and tell him that his rope smells like yak. He will confess he doesn't really make his ropes and will give you a rope for free. You can repeat this several times and get an unlimited amount of ropes.
Walk west to Aggie's house and ask her to make you a yellow dye (using two onions). Dye the wig yellow, to make it look like Keli's blonde hair.

Further, ask Aggie about a skin paste, to lighten Ali's skin tone. Aggie says that she needs a few items to make it - ashes, a pot of flour, redberries and water. Hand over the items to her, in exchange for the paste.

Go inside the jailhouse building. If Lady Keli wasn't in or around the building, wait a little, she'd respawn soon. Talk to her about anything other than Katrine. Tell her that she's famous all over RuneScape. Then ask her about her latest plan and that she must have been very skillful. Then ask her if she's sure that they won't try to break Prince Ali out. She'd tell you it's not possible because there's only one key to Prince Ali's cell and it's on the necklace around her neck.

Ask her if you can see the key for just a moment. Then ask to touch the key. You should have a soft clay with you at this time to make an imprint onto the clay. If you forgot it, you will have to retrieve it and repeat this whole dialogue all over again.

She'll give you a plan on how she intends to do it; you now need to take to the following items to the jailhouse:
• Rope
• Wig (make sure it's been dyed yellow)
• Skin paste
• Pink skirt
• Key
• 3 glasses of Beer
Make sure not to equip the pink skirt, or the plan won't work.

Once Joe is drunk enough that he can't even walk properly, use the rope on Lady Keli to capture her. At this point you should hurry, as Lady Keli will respawn in about a minute or so and attempt to attack you. If she does respawn before you enter the cell with Prince Ali, you need to get another rope and tie up Keli.
p: The entry to the Al Kharid toll gate is now free, after quest completion.

steps.t: Now go pass through the gate that connects Lumbridge and Al Kharid for free, and talk to Chancellor Hassan in the Al Kharid palace to claim your reward.
• The dialogue of the guard Joe in Keli's prison may be based on the Vogon guard in the series wp | The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy .

pic: The boat at the Al Kharid jetty that takes players to Daemonheim.

get_inside.text: Home Teleport to Al Kharid lodestone, just north of the Al Kharid palace.
pic: The gnome glider station, overseen by Captain Dalbur.

get_inside.text: Dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild teleports to Kharid-et Dig Site, close to city's east gate.
Home Teleport to Lumbridge lodestone and run east through the bridge and the opening in the rocks.
From the Lumbridge Swamp, the docks with the ship to Daemonheim give easy access to Al Kharid.
From Daemonheim using the Ring of kinship and finally, sail off Daemonheim to the Al Kharid jetty.
Members who have completed The Grand Tree quest can use the gnome glider to travel to and from Al Kharid.
A Ring of duelling can teleport the player to Het's Oasis, just north-east of Al Kharid.
An Amulet of glory can teleport the player to the Shantay Pass, right outside the south gate of Al Kharid.
Via the one-way fairy ring from the Zanaris market area.
From the desert to the south via the Shantay Pass.
Use the level 8 Agility shortcut to get to and from Lumbridge swamp.
Members who have completed Swept Away and have had their broomstick enchanted by the Sorceress' Apprentice can come via the Sorceress's Garden.
Use the Abyss to teleport to the Fire Altar and then head south.
